messages:
Maya Patel: Quick sync — rethinking what we record in the decision retrospective when an automatic fallback/degrade happens. Current idea: record decision_id, model_from, model_to, trigger_reason, short trace, and a sampled redacted payload. Concerned about storage costs and PI. Thoughts?

Kevin Li: +1 on trimming. Proposal from infra: keep full redacted payloads for 30d, keep metadata (decision_id, trigger, model versions, latency, error rates, rollout_id) for 1 year. Raw payloads hashed + redacted for PII. TTL enforced by retention job.

Sophie Morales: UX note — ops need a compact playback: show sequence of decisions (time, trigger, chosen fallback) and a single "inspect" view for sampled payloads. We should surface the decision path: e.g., "latency spike -> circuit tripped -> fallback to cheaper variant" with links to the trace. Also add small human-friendly reason strings.

Priya Rao: From Console side: please include a decision explanation string and a linkable event_id so PMs/support can jump to the trace. For privacy, make "inspect" gated by role and add a redaction banner. Also we need a CTA to "re-run with same inputs (sanitized)" for debugging.

Kevin Li: Agree on RBAC for payload inspect. On sampling: default 1% of requests but auto-increase to 100% for incidents or when a rollout has >2% fallback rate for 5m. That reduces cost but gives us on-demand fidelity.

Maya Patel: Nice. How do we encode triggers? Want a small enumerated taxonomy: latency_threshold, err_5xx, kvcache_miss, model_unavailable, policy_override, manual_rollback. Use stable reason codes so telemetry queries work.

Sophie Morales: Yes — stable reason codes. Also add a numeric severity score (1-5) so filters can sort noisy low-priority triggers. Example UI filter: show only severity >=3 for last 24h.

Kevin Li: Implementation detail: decision event shape (proposal):
```json
{
  "decision_id":"dec_...",
  "timestamp":"...",
  "from":"redwood/gpt-4.x",
  "to":"redwood/gpt-3.5-xq",
  "trigger":"latency_threshold",
  "reason_code":"lat>500ms",
  "severity":"3",
  "rollout_id":"r_2026_03_A",
  "trace_id":"tr_...",
  "payload_sample_id":"ps_..."
}
```
We store that as metadata in events DB; payload_sample stored in encrypted object storage if sampled.

DeployBot: deploy-bot: noted — we can attach the current deployment hash and rollout window automatically. Also we can emit a CRON that sweeps payload samples past TTL.

Priya Rao: A few edge concerns: 1) customers on Private deployments may require payload retention = 0 by default. 2) Legal/compliance teams might require faster redaction for EU customers. We should make retention per-customer overrideable.

Maya Patel: Good call. Action items: Kevin — draft retention and sampling defaults + ML infra cost estimate. Sophie/Priya — mockup the "decision inspector" UI with severity filter + redaction banner. I'll own the reason-code taxonomy and map to telemetry fields. We'll sync EOD Friday. :white_check_mark:

Kevin Li: I'll have a rough doc by Thursday. +1 on per-customer override.

Sophie Morales: Will prototyping the inspector this week. Sending a quick sketch later. :eyes:

Priya Rao: I can add RBAC controls to the Console checklist and wire the CTA for sanitized re-run.

Maya Patel: Thanks all. If anyone sees major missing items call them out here.

Kevin Li: Minor: remember to include the model quantization/variant tag (q8/q4f16) in metadata so we can correlate quality regressions.

Maya Patel: Great — add that to the schema. Closing for now, will follow up with the taxonomy doc.
